description: Probe 1–10 public Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, or Schema.org DTC product URLs for live title, brand, native currency, price, compare-at price, variants, and explicit public available: true/false status. Unreachable, rate-limited, or WAF-blocked URLs return billable: false ($0). Paid mode (via HTTP header Authorization: Bearer zsk_live_... or X-API-Key) debits 1 credit per reachable billable domain ($0 for DNS/TLS/timeout/5xx/429/WAF failures), enables calibrated AI ICP scoring, and returns a durable job_id recoverable via get_inspection_results.

url.description: Single public product URL (use either url or urls).

urls.description: Array of 1 to 10 public product URLs.
